body: The db:migrate script runs Better Auth CLI, which loads .env.local, then tsx scripts/migrate-catalog.ts, which reads process.env.DATABASE_URL without loading .env.local. With a custom DATABASE_URL only in .env.local, auth and catalog migrations target different SQLite files; seed and maintenance scripts likewise ignore .env.local. Make script environment loading consistent and cover a custom-path regression.
